title: Title.
bodyText: This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the "Hospital Sustainability Program Act".
bodyHtml: [§346G-1]  Title.  This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the "Hospital Sustainability Program Act". [L 2012, c 217, pt of §2, §5; am L 2013, c 141, pt of §1, §2; am L 2014, c 123, §2; am L 2015, c 70, §2; am L 2016, c 60, §3; am L 2017, c 59, §5; am L 2019, c 173, §6; am L 2021, c 38, §7; am L 2023, c 110, §11]
